name: NLR++ Training Loss and Supervision
definition: NLR++ is an end-to-end differentiable neural lumigraph representation optimized to reconstruct target views from a set of input images using a CNN encoder/decoder and a signed distance function (SDF) for shape.
summary: NLR++ Training Loss and Supervision is an end-to-end optimization objective for Neural Lumigraph Representation that distinguishes itself by using a soft mask loss on SDF minima and a scheduled shape supervision strategy to decouple shape approximation from feature refinement.
